relations.subject: Lourens Peter van den Bosch
relations.evidence: From 1965 he studied theology at the University of Groningen, in which subject he graduated in 1968 (candidaatsexamen) and 1971 (doctoraalexamen). In 1973 he graduated in the Indonesian languages
